additionalPrimarySources.scope: Text and rendered pages: dimensions, central building exterior/interior, later rotunda, and small inset historic 1841 plan. No complete dimensioned central floor plan asserted.
additionalPrimarySources.rightsReview: Public municipal report contains credited third-party historic images and drawings. Reference only; no PDF or report pixels redistributed in art/runtime pack.

itemInterpretation.ny1600: Main Hospital Building No. 2; later uses visible in surveyed room labels.
itemInterpretation.ma1289: Mill No. 4 main range; Mill 4 North and the connector are context rather than copied entire complex.
itemInterpretation.ma0469: Sheet 1 partial central market exterior; sheets 2/3 are distinct North/South Market buildings. Not three central market floor plans.
